coverage.obligation: Four explicit behaviors, regression preservation and compatible state transfer
Baseline list vs canonical-set semantics for both origins, with or without reindex
Replacement, origin preservation, per-entry collision scope and repeated evaluation
Date direction, ties, missingness, zero and invalid present dates
Accepted empty/minimum/maximum bounds, exact strings and rejection immediately outside limits
Object shapes, types, required/unknown keys and common grammar
Validation gate order, full-state validation and lookup
Exact success/refusal envelopes, input nonmutation, detached outputs
coverage.note: These cases additionally require the universal pre/post input equality and input/output container-disjointness checks specified by the contract. Response-only matching is insufficient.
